state:
**Goal `ext-intl`: Stage 8, the feature proofs, is in progress.** Stages 1 to 7 are on disk, and every `Novis\Intl` feature owes nothing: the nine classes and the 14 enums.

The 182 stale perf figures are re-measured and appended to `docs/perf/members.ndjson`. The machine was busy, so `unit_ns` is higher than in earlier records, but the normalised `ratio` agrees with them (`Core\Uuid::parse`: 3414 now, 3702 before).

Still red: `bun nv proofs --gate`, now 14 of 1280 features. All 14 are implemented features that landed on 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-07, outside this goal, with no proof and no skip entry: nine `Novis\Image` features (`Diff::constructor`, `Image::mime`, `Image::extension`, `Codec::compare`, `::hash`, `::placeholder`, `::palette`, `::qr`, the enum `Output`), plus `ExtensionError`, `Core\DeprecatedError` and the directives `errors.deprecated`, `image.max_pixels` and `ext`. A gap record does not satisfy the gate: `owed()` in `tools/nv/proofs/collect.ts:430` counts only proofs and skip entries. A skip entry is only for a proof that cannot exist, so these 14 are closed with proofs.

The check's argv is the whole roster, so this goal owns all 14. The nine `Novis\Image` features live under `extensions/image/`, where by-hand commits were still landing on 2026-10-07. Writing their proofs from the loop risks colliding with that work. That is the one question for the user, and it is in the backlog.

next.note: one file set: `docs/examples/types/`, `docs/examples/config/`, `tests/hostile/types/`, `tests/hostile/config/` and a `covers:` line each in `tests/conformance/`.

items.text: **Write the proofs `ExtensionError` and `Core\DeprecatedError` owe**: an about page, one example, one attack and one test each (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `ExtensionError` is thrown when a guest traps, mapped at `crates/nvs-ext/src/call.rs:445`. `Core\DeprecatedError` is what `[errors] deprecated = "throw"` throws, documented at `crates/nvs-config/src/errors.rs:36`. Find where the runtime declares it before writing the example.

**Write the proofs the directives `errors.deprecated`, `image.max_pixels` and `ext` owe**: an about page, one example and one attack each, and a test each for `errors.deprecated` and `ext` (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). The directives are at `crates/nvs-config/src/directive.rs:168`, `crates/nvs-config/src/directive.rs:229` and `crates/nvs-config/src/directive.rs:286`. Run `bun nv proofs --comments` over every new `.nvs` and `about.md`.

backlog: The nine `Novis\Image` features owe every proof: about, three examples, an attack, a bench and two tests each (`Output` owes about, one example and one test). Once the group above lands, they are the only thing keeping `bun nv proofs --gate` red. Unless the by-hand image work has finished by then, the next session writes `BLOCKED` and asks the user whether the loop should write these proofs. The declarations are `extensions/image/nvs/Diff.nvs:9`, `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:92`, `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:107`, `extensions/image/manifest.json:33-87` and `extensions/image/src/lib.rs:697-740`.

`rule:packaging/the-first-party-components-are-built-in` says the image component implements only `info`, `run` and `variants`. `compare`, `hash`, `placeholder`, `palette` and `qr` are implemented now (`extensions/image/src/lib.rs:697-740`), so the fragment is stale.

`--record-perf` notes `known-gap: // bench: complexity quadratic is not one of constant, linear, nlogn, karatsuba` on several `Core\BigInt` benches (`benches/members/core/BigInt/`). It does not make the gate fail.
